I added `creator/design.py` (K08 design generation) and `tests/test_creator_design.py`. The 7 new tests pass. I didn't run the rest of the suite, and the system-computed checks (adoption, audit, TESTED transition) haven't run.

The module follows the K08 line in `creator/ARCHITECTURE.md` and the style of `research.py`. It builds up to N alternative designs per decision, runs an adversarial critique on each, and scores them against explicit weighted criteria. It then selects the best one and keeps every other option as rejected, each with a reason. Public functions and classes have docstrings stating their contract, and the imports are package-relative, so nothing depends on the repo root.

The tests cover the empty and failure cases: no candidates, `n=0`, duplicate or blank names, unknown or zero-weight criteria, and selecting from no options. They also check that rejected alternatives are kept and that changing the criteria changes the winner.

The scoring weights (cost 0.3, risk 0.4, benefit 0.3) and the 0.02 penalty per critique issue are my own choices, since the architecture file doesn't specify them.

STATUS: DONE
